name: How to Convert JPG to PDF
description: Convert JPG, PNG and WebP images to a single PDF — free, no upload.

step.name: Add your images
step.text: Click 'Choose files' or drag your JPG, PNG or WebP images into the drop zone. Multiple images are combined into one PDF.

step.name: Reorder the images
step.text: Drag the image cards to set the page order in the output PDF. EXIF rotation is applied automatically.

step.name: Download the PDF
step.text: Click 'Convert to PDF'. Your images are packaged into a single PDF and download immediately.
